result.title: Inverse Modeling for Laser Pulse Shape Design in Inertial Confinement Fusion
result.comment: Initial version submitted to NeurIPS 2026 pending publication
result.summary: The achievement of practical fusion energy remains one of the most pressing unsolved scientific challenges, with immense implications for carbon-free power. A critical factor in the success of Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) is the design of a Laser Pulse Shape (LP) that can optimally drive implosions under stringent physical constraints. Traditional LP design relies on computationally expensive simulations and manual iterative refinement. We introduce the ICF Laser Pulse Shape Design System (LPDS), a generative inverse modeling framework that maps desired outcomes and target pellet configurations directly to optimized LPs. Crucially, we design a multi-objective loss function to ensure the generated LPs satisfy fundamental physical constraints and experimental requirements. Furthermore, we present constraint-conditioning, inpainting, and gradient-based LP editing mechanisms for fine-grained control over specific pulse characteristics during generation. Moreover, we study the transfer of our framework to a limited set of real experimental shots. Our method establishes a data-driven inverse design framework for LP design in ICF, contributing to the advancement of practical and sustainable fusion energy.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ICF 激光脉冲波形设计的生成式逆向建模系统 LPDS，由目标结果与靶丸配置直接生成满足物理约束的激光脉冲，并结合多目标损失、约束条件化、inpainting 与梯度编辑实现细粒度控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作远离视觉推理主线，但其「目标结果到受限序列」的逆向条件生成与约束满足思路，可能为 LVR 中由答案/证据反推 latent 轨迹、以及在物理或格式约束下编辑推理状态提供概念类比，需核查其约束损失与编辑机制是否可迁移。
